# Port4 (port4.dev)

> Paid MCP gateway for monetizing any HTTP API per call with USDC or Tempo OUSD via the x402 v2 payment protocol, Visa Trusted Agent Protocol (TAP), and Cloudflare Code Mode.

## Overview
Port4 turns REST APIs, OpenAPI 3.x specs, or upstream MCP servers into pay-per-call Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoints hosted at `https://{tenant}.port4.dev/mcp` (or `https://port4.dev/mcp/{tenant}`). AI agents discover tools and pay per invocation using HTTP 402 (`x402` v2 or Tempo OUSD MPP) without creating an account.

## Links
- Homepage: https://port4.dev
- Developer Docs: https://port4.dev/docs
- Interactive Sandbox: https://port4.dev/sandbox
- Console / Dashboard: https://port4.dev/dashboard (alias `/console`)
- OpenAPI Discovery (`x-payment-info`): `GET https://{tenant}.port4.dev/openapi.json` and `GET https://port4.dev/mcp/{tenant}/openapi.json`
- CLI & STDIO Bridge: `npx -y port4-mcp` (`packages/port4-mcp`)
- GitHub: https://github.com/Port4-dev
- Contact: info@port4.dev

## Protocol Summary
- Transport: Stateless HTTP `POST` with JSON-RPC 2.0
- MCP Spec: `2026-07-28` (no `initialize` handshake, no `Mcp-Session-Id`)
- Required Headers:
  - `Content-Type: application/json`
  - `MCP-Protocol-Version: 2026-07-28`
  - `Mcp-Method: tools/list | tools/call`
  - `Mcp-Name: <tool_name>` (required for `tools/call`; use `code` in `codemode`, or `search` / `execute` in `openapi_codemode`)
- Payment Protocols:
  - **x402 v2 (`PAYMENT-REQUIRED`, `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`, `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` Base64 JSON headers)**
  - **Tempo OUSD MPP (`WWW-Authenticate: Payment`, `Authorization: Payment <b64url>`, `Payment-Receipt`)**
- Optional Agent Identity & Access Control:
  - **Visa Trusted Agent Protocol (TAP)**: `require_visa_tap` (with optional `allow_tap_simulated`) verifies RFC 9421 Ed25519 signatures (`Signature-Input`, `Signature`, `Content-Digest`, `Signature-Agent`) against `auth.visacli.sh` and forwards `X-Port4-Tap-Agent` upstream.
  - **Cloudflare One Access (`x402+oauth_v2`)**: `Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion` or `CF-Access-Client-Id` + `CF-Access-Client-Secret`.
- Cloudflare Code Mode (`@cloudflare/codemode` + `LOADER`):
  - `direct`: 1 tool = 1 paid call
  - `codemode`: single `code` tool executing multi-step JavaScript inside an isolated Dynamic Worker (`globalOutbound: null`)
  - `openapi_codemode`: `search` (free) + `execute` (paid)

## Supported Settlement Networks (12 Chains via `GET /api/networks`)
- **EVM Circle USDC (`exact` scheme, `0x...`):**
  - Base Mainnet (`eip155:8453`)
  - Base Sepolia (`eip155:84532`)
  - Arbitrum One (`eip155:42161`)
  - Arbitrum Sepolia (`eip155:421614`)
  - Optimism (`eip155:10`)
  - Polygon PoS (`eip155:137`)
  - Ethereum Mainnet (`eip155:1`)
  - Avalanche C-Chain (`eip155:43114`)
- **Tempo OUSD (`exact` / MPP, `0x...`):**
  - Tempo Mainnet (`eip155:4217`)
  - Tempo Testnet (`eip155:42431`)
- **Solana SPL USDC (`exact` scheme, Base58):**
  - Solana Mainnet (`solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp`)
  - Solana Devnet (`solana:EtWTRABZaYq6iMfeYKouRu166VU2xqa1`)

## Demo Endpoint
- Endpoint: `https://port4.dev/mcp/demo` (also `https://demo.port4.dev/mcp` and `https://port4.dev/sandbox/mcp`)
- Tools:
  - `ping` ($0.001 USDC) — `{ "message": "hello port4" }`
  - `market_quote` ($0.001 USDC) — `{ "symbol": "ETH-USD" }`
  - `edge_dns_lookup` ($0.002 USDC) — `{ "domain": "port4.dev" }`

## Control Plane API (Developers)
Authenticate with a scoped Bearer API key (`Authorization: Bearer p4_live_...`):
- `GET https://port4.dev/api/networks` — List all 12 supported settlement networks
- `GET https://port4.dev/api/tenants` — List your endpoints and tools
- `POST https://port4.dev/api/tenants` — Create a paid MCP endpoint
- `PATCH https://port4.dev/api/tenants/:id` — Update endpoint config, payout wallets, Code Mode, Visa TAP, or CF Access
- `DELETE https://port4.dev/api/tenants/:id` — Archive an endpoint
- `POST https://port4.dev/api/tenants/:id/verify-upstream` — Verify upstream domain via `/.well-known/port4-verification.txt`
- `POST https://port4.dev/api/tenants/:id/rotate-secret` — Rotate upstream HMAC signing secret
- `POST https://port4.dev/api/tenants/:id/import-openapi` — Import OpenAPI 3.x spec into tools
- `POST https://port4.dev/api/tenants/:id/sync-mcp` — Sync tools from an upstream MCP server
- `POST https://port4.dev/api/tenants/:id/test-call` — Execute an owner-authenticated upstream test call
- `POST https://port4.dev/api/tenants/:id/tools` — Add a paid tool to an endpoint
- `PATCH https://port4.dev/api/tenants/:id/tools/:toolId` — Update a tool
- `DELETE https://port4.dev/api/tenants/:id/tools/:toolId` — Delete a tool
- `GET https://port4.dev/api/ledger` — Fetch settled transactions, pagination, daily series, and revenue summary
- `GET https://port4.dev/api/ledger/export?format=csv|json` — Export filtered ledger transactions
- `GET/POST/DELETE https://port4.dev/api/keys` — Manage scoped API keys (`tenant:read`, `tenant:write`, `ledger:read`)
- `GET https://port4.dev/api/billing/plans` & `POST https://port4.dev/api/billing/upgrade` — Plan tiers & Stripe upgrade
